2026-07-23 12:22:11.576158 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:

2026-07-23 12:22:11.576171 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-07-23 12:22:11.576175 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-07-23 12:22:11.576178 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-07-23 12:22:11.576182 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-07-23 12:22:11.576185 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
